newsitem.title: USA: Gilbert backs view of after-tax sale.
newsitem.headline: Gilbert backs view of after-tax sale.

text.p: Gilbert Associates Inc said Wednesday its divestitures of technical services companies and real estate are proceeding and it expects to announce the sale of SRA in the near future.
The sale of RCI, its government contracting subsidiary, will take longer, but could possibly be accomplished in the third quarter.

Because of difficulties and delays in receiving a favorable private letter ruling from the Internal Revenue Service on its request to do a tax-free spin off, to dispose of its real estate operations, the company said it now plans to sell the real estate in a taxable transaction.
It is anticipated that the sale could be take place within 90 days, the company said.
The company remains comfortable with prior estimates that the sale of the three businesses could generate after-tax proceeds of $50 million to $60 million.
